title: AARO undercut by CIA and Air Force figures such as Kirkpatrick
summary: Matthew Pines tells of AARO undercut by CIA and Air Force figures such as Kirkpatrick, about 2022-2024 at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: over there And then of course when it moves into arrow it's kind of compromised by the CIA air force guys right like Kirkpatrick.
AARO was acting as a counterintelligence against the American public
tellings.difference: Goes further: AARO acted as counterintelligence against the public and as a honey trap that harassed whistleblowers. Credits Lacatski, Phillips and Knapp.
tellings.link_reason: Both say AARO under Kirkpatrick, 2022-2024, was compromised and worked against disclosure.
